Synthetic JFET operating-point witnesses measured independently in SIMetrix
Elements 9.40d at 27, 65 and 85 °C. Both polarities use the original
15 pA saturation current with explicit XTI=0, 2, 3 and omitted XTI.
Native P-channel internal ig is sign-normalized, unlike terminal current
reported by the source simulator; reference CSV uses the native sign.
Tolerance: 0.1 pA absolute + 0.1% relative, allowing the independently
measured discrepancy between historical and modern physical constants.
